sharedConstraints: One original fictional young adult character; square head-and-shoulders 2D cel-shaded anime portrait; plain matte background; no existing IP or identifiable person; no text, logo, watermark, signature, hands, props, or additional faces.

cases.clean-coral: Centered straight-on character with coral-red bobbed hair and amber eyes, crisp dark line art, both complete eyes and closed mouth unobstructed.
cases.clean-lavender: Centered straight-on character with short lavender hair and emerald-green eyes, crisp line art, both complete eyes and closed mouth unobstructed.
cases.dark-iris-navy: Centered straight-on character with navy hair and extremely dark brown almost-black irises that remain subtly distinguishable from black pupils, restrained highlights.
cases.dark-iris-auburn: Centered straight-on character with dark auburn hair and very dark forest-green irises, small pupils, minimal highlights, deliberately low iris-to-pupil contrast.
cases.light-iris-silver: Centered straight-on character with pale silver hair, very light ice-blue irises, pale skin, subtle light-gray pupils, high-key light, fine gray line art, intentionally low contrast.
cases.light-iris-peach: Centered straight-on character with pale peach-blonde hair, very light golden-yellow irises and warm-gray pupils, pastel high-key treatment, intentionally low iris-to-sclera contrast.
cases.occluded-left-eye: Mostly frontal character with long black hair and violet eyes; exactly one natural diagonal bang partially hides the left eye while the right eye and mouth remain visible.
cases.glasses-round: Centered straight-on character with chestnut hair, blue-green eyes and thin round transparent-lens glasses; rims cross near eye regions without opaque reflections.
cases.three-quarter: Character with teal-black hair and copper eyes turned about 25 degrees; both eyes visible but asymmetric from perspective; not profile and not straight-on.
cases.low-resolution-192: Centered straight-on character with golden-brown hair and purple eyes, strong simple silhouettes designed to remain legible after deterministic downsampling to 192 by 192 pixels.
